name: pinnable-list
title: Pinnable list
description: A list where items can be pinned to the top: a Pinned group, a pin toggle on each row and an order you control.
docs: Give it items with an id and a label, and hold the pinned ids yourself (pinned and onPinnedChange) or let it hold them (defaultPinned). The order of items is the order inside each group. Set maxPinned to cap it: at the limit the other pin buttons switch off and the reason is written under the group title.
